detail.longDescription: A Google Form is the easy part: questions in, responses out. What happens next is where things stall. Someone has to notice the new submission, thank the respondent, tell the team, and add a task. Connect Zapier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor, tell your agent what should happen with each response, and it builds the workflow for you. Zapier runs it from there, no open chat needed.
